title: Mortality
description: The chance of dying in a year of life, by age and body (M2.7, D103): the US period life table's, per 100,000, between rows read as a straight line; and what raises it. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

table.description: Rows by age, in order: the chance of dying within a year at that age, per 100,000, for a body that can carry a pregnancy and one that can't (the life table's female and male).

health.description: Health let fall raises the chance: below the level, it is multiplied (tune).
